entities.name: Premature low-birth-weight infant
observations: Infant born at 33 weeks with birth weight 1550 g; birth weight is below 2000 g, which affects hepatitis B vaccine timing when maternal HBsAg is negative.

entities.name: Hepatitis B vaccine
observations: For an infant weighing <2000 g at birth whose mother is HBsAg-negative, the first hepatitis B vaccine dose is deferred until age 1 month or hospital discharge, whichever comes first; if maternal HBsAg is positive or unknown, vaccination and HBIG are given promptly.

source_tools.relevance: CDC/ACIP immunization rule summarized for this scenario

entities.name: DTaP vaccine
observations: DTaP is routinely initiated at 2 months of chronological age in preterm infants; vaccine timing is based on chronological rather than corrected gestational age.

entities.name: PCV13 vaccine
observations: Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine is routinely initiated at 2 months of chronological age in preterm infants.
